europe_now.title: Russian Attacks on Ukrainian Energy Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Russian forces launched a major series of strikes targeting energy infrastructure across Ukraine. The coordinated assault resulted in widespread power cuts and exacerbated existing regional vulnerabilities.

sources.headline: Russia launches major attack on Ukraine’s energy grid, causing power cuts

europe_now.title: Escalation in French Student Protests
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations and school blockades across France have intensified significantly. Clashes between student protesters and law enforcement officers have led to hundreds of arrests.

sources.headline: France: Hundreds arrested as student protests escalate

top_stories.title: European Migration and Deportation Policy
top_stories.summary: Several European Union member states have announced plans to establish the bloc's first offshore deportation center in Africa by 2027. Meanwhile, judicial and policy developments regarding migration enforcement continue to evolve across various countries.
